spans.s: लोमश्य the utterance of an aspirate letter rather harshly, with a stress on it, when that utterance is look- ed upon as a fault; cf. ऊष्मणां घोषाणां लोमश्यमसौकुमार्ये श्र्वेडनम् अधिको वर्णस्य ध्वनिः Uvvața on R. Pr.

लोमादि a class of words headed by the word लोमन् to which the tad. affix, श, in the sense 'possessed of' is added optionally along with the usual affix मत् ( मतुप् ); e.g. लोमश:, लोमवान्, रोमश: रोमवान् बभ्रुशः, हरिश:, कपिश: etc. cf. Kas. on
